No activity yet

Every save and every “Don’t save” shows up here.

narrative.overview: The panel is a desk where one person reads a proposed change and decides. The text of the change has the lead role; lists, badges and buttons are the desk around it. The panel is a guest in the Hermes Desktop app: it uses the app's UI kit and theme variables, so it changes with the owner's theme and never brings its own palette or font.
keyCharacteristics: Reading first: the change text is the largest, calmest block on the page.
One accent, used for the chosen item and the main action.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; no drop shadows.
Three tabs, one level; a list on the left, the chosen item beside it.
Empty is a normal, pleasant state.

rules.name: The Guest Rule
rules.body: No hex value in the panel. A colour is a --ui-* variable or a color-mix of one with transparent.

rules.name: The 12-13 Rule
rules.body: Almost all text is 12 or 13 px. A larger size marks exactly one thing on screen.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A drop shadow belongs to the app's menus, not to the panel.

dos: Do give the change text the most room and the strongest ink.
donts: Don't write a hex colour or set a font family.
